text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: New Year's Day…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Many students have gone home for the winter break. With them gone for the next few days, the academy has been quiet and still, like a fire's gone out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite the change of pace, I can't afford to just lounge around. This year, my trainee's entering her all-important classic year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I review last year's race results and training logs before carefully writing up a plan for this year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After all, Admire Vega will be facing the incredibly trying Classic Triple Crown tour. No amount of preparation can be enough for this challenge.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With that in mind, I enthusiastically press on with my tasks, but…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gurgle…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite making sure to bring everything I need for work, I completely forgot to prepare any food. I'm also entirely out of ready-to-eat meals and snacks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With fingers crossed, I visit the nearby shopping district, only to find that everywhere is closed due to the holiday.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Ah…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …Happy New Year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Admire Vega returns my greeting. She's wearing a tracksuit, and her cheeks are slightly flushed—it appears she's already started training diligently.
choice_data_list: Are you doing some shopping too?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Yes, I ran out of sports drink powder…
choice_data_list: Aren't we lucky convenience stores are open on New Year's Day?
Aren't we lucky convenience stores are open on New Year's Day?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Yes, it's a big help… always.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hearing her throw out the word "always," I suddenly realize she likely doesn't return home, even during the holidays.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She has her reasons, which I certainly can't change, but…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'm going to finish my shopping. See you…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Yes?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing as we bumped into each other, I offer to help finish her shopping while I get my lunch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite her tenacious refusal, I convince her to let an adult handle things.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In fact, I decide to throw in a little extra while I'm at it. But what to choose?
choice_data_list: A hot snack to cheer her up.
Something sweet to clear her mind.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: What's this?
choice_data_list: I thought you could use it. It's cold outside, you know.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Well, thanks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Admire Vega starts to eat the piping hot meat bun, so I take a bite out of the one I got for myself.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Are you okay? Is it too hot for you?
choice_data_list: Yeah, a little I guess… Not you?
Yeah, a little I guess… Not you?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'm fine… I don't have a problem with hot food.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: They say you should eat without letting the food touch the tip of your tongue. I don't know if it works, though…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After a bit, I enjoy my delicious meat bun.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It isn't one with any extra stuff in it, is it?
choice_data_list: Like a New Year's gift kinda thing?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: A what?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Never mind… Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …It's cold out.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (And dreary… I guess because the others aren't here.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Ah, that reminds me…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Ahh…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …So warm.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh, a dessert?
choice_data_list: They called it the Fluffy Vanilla Soufflé!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You… really didn't need to.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff… Phew!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (So soft…)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whirrrr… Whirrrr…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Okay. I just have to wait for the laundry to dry.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (Fluffy…)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Munch.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (It is fluffy!)
